# Roadmap — lege-docwrite

Live milestones in `after` order, then standing tracks. Acceptance verdicts are computed
from evidence under the descendant-commit rule (D-016).

## Milestones

### M1 — editor spike: one editable paged document at full speed

`completed` · `@docwrite.milestone.m1-editor-spike/2`

One editable paged document with caret, selection, undo/redo, Unicode and IME input,
paragraphs, real font shaping, exact PageUp/PageDown and snap-on-gesture-end,
incremental pagination and latency instrumentation. Prove that 200–500 pages remain
instantaneous before anything ornamental is built.

**Acceptance** — 4 of 4 satisfied

| Check | Method | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `convergent-repagination` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-incremental/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |
| `edit-basics` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-edits/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |
| `exact-paging` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-navigation/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |
| `five-hundred-pages` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-latency/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |

**Depends on** [Incremental pagination stops when page geometry converges](DECISION-HISTORY.md#revision-1--incremental-pagination-stops-when-page-geometry-converges) `@docwrite.decision.incremental-pagination/1`, [Book text is shaped with harfrust and skrifa, broken with unicode-linebreak and hypher](DECISION-HISTORY.md#revision-1--book-text-is-shaped-with-harfrust-and-skrifa-broken-with-unicode-linebreak-and-hypher) `@docwrite.decision.text-stack/1`, [The app is hosted on pixelkit; viewer ideas are ported, not depended on](DECISION-HISTORY.md#revision-1--the-app-is-hosted-on-pixelkit-viewer-ideas-are-ported-not-depended-on) `@docwrite.decision.ui-stack-pixelkit/1`, [Enable IME and expose a cursor-area API](ACTIVE-WORK.md#enable-ime-and-expose-a-cursor-area-api) `@pixelkit.work.ime/1`, [Full text input and key events](ACTIVE-WORK.md#full-text-input-and-key-events) `@pixelkit.work.key-input/1`, [Input-to-present latency in FrameTimer](ACTIVE-WORK.md#input-to-present-latency-in-frametimer) `@pixelkit.work.latency-phase/1`, [Injectable Presenter in run_app/WindowConfig](ACTIVE-WORK.md#injectable-presenter-in-run_appwindowconfig) `@pixelkit.work.presenter-injection/1`, [Forward scroll TouchPhase and magnify gestures](ACTIVE-WORK.md#forward-scroll-touchphase-and-magnify-gestures) `@pixelkit.work.scroll-phase-gestures/1`

**Work items** — _(none)_

### M2 — book core: the first useful release

`completed` · `@docwrite.milestone.m2-book-core/2` · after `@docwrite.milestone.m1-editor-spike/2`

Chapters and parts, the Book Map with drag reorder, semantic paragraph/character styles,
page masters, chapter templates, facing pages, margins, page numbers, running heads,
recto starts, save/load in the .legebook bundle with atomic autosave, and Markdown and
searchable PDF export.

**Acceptance** — 4 of 4 satisfied

| Check | Method | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exports` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-exports/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |
| `global-style-change` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-restyle/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |
| `reorder-and-reopen` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-persistence/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |
| `ten-chapter-book` | manual | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-persistence/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |

**Depends on** [PDF is generated by Lege, IDML replaces native INDD, Markdown drops geometry](DECISION-HISTORY.md#revision-1--pdf-is-generated-by-lege-idml-replaces-native-indd-markdown-drops-geometry) `@docwrite.decision.export-formats/1`, [A book is a .legebook directory bundle with atomic autosave and named snapshots](DECISION-HISTORY.md#revision-1--a-book-is-a-legebook-directory-bundle-with-atomic-autosave-and-named-snapshots) `@docwrite.decision.persistence-bundle/1`, [Styles, page masters and chapter templates are three separate systems](DECISION-HISTORY.md#revision-1--styles-page-masters-and-chapter-templates-are-three-separate-systems) `@docwrite.decision.styles-masters-templates/1`, [lege-pdf-write: subset and embed TrueType and CFF fonts](ACTIVE-WORK.md#lege-pdf-write-subset-and-embed-truetype-and-cff-fonts) `@lege.work.font-subsetting-and-cff/1`, [lege-pdf-write: links, named destinations and page labels](ACTIVE-WORK.md#lege-pdf-write-links-named-destinations-and-page-labels) `@lege.work.links-labels-destinations/1`, [lege-pdf-write: several fonts per page and per-cluster ToUnicode](ACTIVE-WORK.md#lege-pdf-write-several-fonts-per-page-and-per-cluster-tounicode) `@lege.work.multi-font-pages-and-tounicode/1`, [lege-pdf-write: path operators, RGB fill and Flate images](ACTIVE-WORK.md#lege-pdf-write-path-operators-rgb-fill-and-flate-images) `@lege.work.vector-paths-and-color/1`

### M3 — serious prose typography

`completed` · `@docwrite.milestone.m3-prose-typography/2` · after `@docwrite.milestone.m2-book-core/2`

Hyphenation, widow/orphan control, keep-with-next and keep-lines-together, first
paragraph rules, optional drop caps, block quotes and epigraphs, image/caption flow,
front and back matter, a generated table of contents, small caps and old-style figures
through OpenType features.

**Acceptance** — 2 of 2 satisfied

| Check | Method | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `generated-toc` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-toc/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |
| `paragraph-rules` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-rules/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |

**Work items** — _(none)_

### M4 — research and apparatus

`completed` · `@docwrite.milestone.m4-research-apparatus/2` · after `@docwrite.milestone.m3-prose-typography/2`

Footnotes and endnotes with page-local placement, Source records, Source Notes captured
from a Lege PDF opened beside the manuscript (document, page, passage, bibliographic
metadata, annotation), citations and quotations inserted from them, click-through back to
the exact source page, a bibliography, index terms, "sources used in this chapter", and
CSL JSON / BibTeX import and export.

**Acceptance** — 2 of 2 satisfied

| Check | Method | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `footnotes-paginate` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-blank-verso/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |
| `source-roundtrip` | manual | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-source/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |

**Work items** — _(none)_

### M5 — publishing interchange

`completed` · `@docwrite.milestone.m5-interchange/2` · after `@docwrite.milestone.m4-research-apparatus/2`

IDML export (styles, parent pages, threaded story, anchored images, footnotes), richer
template interchange, optional EPUB, stronger import, book validation/preflight, font
embedding warnings and final-output checks.

> **Note:** idml-opens is explicitly waived. No Adobe InDesign binary is installed (not on PATH, not under /Applications, not found by Spotlight). The IDML package is still produced. It was not opened in InDesign, and inspecting the package XML is not a pass of that check.

**Acceptance** — 1 of 1 satisfied

| Check | Method | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `preflight` | command | **satisfied** by `@docwrite.evidence.head-preflight/1` (pass at `5e5eba97`) |

**Depends on** [PDF is generated by Lege, IDML replaces native INDD, Markdown drops geometry](DECISION-HISTORY.md#revision-1--pdf-is-generated-by-lege-idml-replaces-native-indd-markdown-drops-geometry) `@docwrite.decision.export-formats/1`, [lege-pdf-write: /Lang and a structure tree](ACTIVE-WORK.md#lege-pdf-write-lang-and-a-structure-tree) `@lege.work.tagged-pdf/1`

**Work items** — _(none)_
